message.content:
(1) Overall layout structure: MATCH (Both use a 3-pane layout: left sidebar for navigation, center file list, and right details/preview pane).
(2) Information architecture: DIFF (Image 1 has a top progress bar and bottom action bar; Image 2 moves the progress bar to the bottom, adds a "Condition" column to the list, and includes a "Save this search" button).
(3) Color palette family: MATCH (Both utilize a light theme with a primary blue accent color and neutral grays).
(4) Typography scale: MATCH (Both use a clear hierarchy with bold headers for panes and standard sans-serif fonts for list items).
(5) Control geometry: DIFF (Image 2's list is significantly denser with more columns and smaller row heights compared to Image 1's spacious folder view).
(6) Primary CTA placement: MATCH (The primary "Recover All" CTA is positioned in the bottom-right corner of the interface in both versions).

VERDICT: STRUCTURALLY_DIVERGENT. While the high-level 3-pane layout is similar, the re-implementation significantly alters the information density, column structure, and the placement of the scanning status/progress indicators.
